known_constraints: Sign-in (story 72) and the role store (stories 73, 75, 76) come first: every other story needs an authenticated, role-scoped caller.
Story 20 (upload pipeline) is built before the four parser stories 20a-20d, which are independent of each other and can run in parallel.
Submitting a VA Submission (story 40) needs the declaration (41), proposing statuses (35) and at least one parser.
Cyber Manager review (stories 48-58) needs a submitted VA Submission (40); endorsement (64-71) needs a reviewed one (57).
Exemptions (43-47) and Register retirement effects (5-7) need the VA Submission state machine (19, 40, 57, 65).
Reminders (88-90) need the Quarter windows and the Overdue flag (16, 42, 71) and the notification outbox (91, 92).
